Derive fixed-order large-n moment limits rigorously to investigate eventual failure for cap five.
publicSummary: The assertion is false: B_{800,≤5} has a nonreal zero. After removing x^160, an exact 20×20 power-sum Hankel determinant is negative, contradicting a necessary condition for real-rootedness. A standalone exact verifier is included.

scope.description: The universal assertion is refuted by the admissible pair (n,m)=(800,5). No minimality or classification of other pairs is claimed.
